en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural landscape with a curving roadside tram or rail track running alongside an unpaved road. Overhead wires are carried by a series of arched metal poles. Dense vegetation and fields occupy the left side, with a white farmhouse partially visible among trees. The scene is calm and slightly hilly. In the lower right corner, the caption reads "Mooi Nederland".
